tweets.text:
On 3/17, USBP agents in Louisiana apprehended a Mexican national and DACA recipient involved in alien smuggling. The individual picked up a Mexican national in Austin, TX, with plans to transport him to Florida. The DACA recipient was turned over to ICE to terminate his status and the illegal alien will be prosecuted for illegal re-entry (8USC1326).

Illegal actions like these undermine the integrity and privilege of any special immigration program-with privilege comes the responsibility to uphold the law.

USBP working with Colombian National Police, played a key role in tracking down a wanted murderer hiding in the U.S. The suspect, a Colombian citizen, is wanted for orchestrating the assassination of his own cousin, allegedly hiring two hitmen & providing them with an escape route. His days of evading arrest ended in Olathe, KS, where @HSIKansasCity  and @FBIKansasCity  apprehended him. He is now in custody pending removal.

If you think you can hide in the U.S.- think again.

WATCH actual footage of the incident obtained by @CityNoticiasTv Colombian news outlet.

AGGRAVATED FELONS APPREHENDED

On 3/19, USBP agents near Dateland, AZ, arrested five illegal aliens, two of which are convicted felons.

Their criminal history includes:
▪️ Convictions for grand theft auto, mail theft, false ID to a peace officer, and ties to the Dog Patch gang in Southwest LA.
▪️ Deported in 2024, with convictions for assault and aggravated DUI.

Both face prosecution for felony illegal re-entry (8 USC 1326) and improper entry (8 USC 1325).

USBP agents took swift action on March 20, 2025, in Richland, WA, arresting a child molester and making our communities safer! Working alongside ICE agents, they apprehended a convicted sex offender previously sentenced for crimes against minors. The individual is now in custody, facing charges under INA §212(a)(6)(A)(i) for being present without admission or parole and has been placed in removal proceedings.
 
We’re committed to using all resources to identify and remove criminal aliens from our communities!
